Class Obstacle

java.lang.Object
core.entities.base.GameObject
core.entities.base.Obstacle
Direct Known Subclasses:
AirObstacle, GroundObstacle
public abstract class Obstacle extends GameObject
Base class for all obstacles. Responsibilities: - Move toward the player - Handle obstacle lifetime - Store damage value - Support custom obstacle behavior Subclasses: - Spike - Bat - Fireball - CandyWall
